Scatter plot of neighbourhood-level metrics

Source: R/plot_nhood_scatter.R
plot_nhood_scatter.Rd

Plots two neighbourhood-level metrics against each other, with point size optionally scaled by a neighbourhood-level column and colour mapped to a grouping variable.

Usage

plot_nhood_scatter(
  nhood_data,
  x_col = NULL,
  y_col = NULL,
  x_reliability_col = NULL,
  y_reliability_col = NULL,
  colour_by = NULL,
  size_by = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  alpha = 0.8,
  facet_by = NULL,
  facet_ncol = NULL,
  facet_scales = "free",
  add_density = FALSE,
  x_lab = NULL,
  y_lab = NULL
)

Arguments

nhood_data

Data frame containing all columns to plot.

x_col

Column name (string) for the x-axis metric (default "shannon_diversity").

y_col

Column name (string) for the y-axis metric (default "mean_shm").

x_reliability_col

Column name of a logical reliability flag for the x-axis metric. Neighbourhoods where this column is FALSE or NA are dropped before plotting, regardless of their y-axis reliability. NULL skips this filter.

y_reliability_col

Column name of a logical reliability flag for the y-axis metric. Neighbourhoods where this column is FALSE or NA are dropped before plotting, regardless of their x-axis reliability. NULL skips this filter.

colour_by

Column name (string) for point colour (default "anat").

size_by

Column name (string) to map point size to, or NULL (default) for a fixed point size.

size

Controls point size and depends on size_by:

  • When size_by is NULL — a single numeric giving the fixed point size (default 2 when size is left NULL).

  • When size_by is a column name — a numeric vector of length 2 giving the minimum and maximum point size of the size scale (default c(1, 4) when size is left NULL).

alpha

Numeric between 0-1. Point transparency (default 0.8).

facet_by

Column name to facet by, or NULL for no faceting.

facet_ncol

Number of columns for facet_wrap (NULL = auto).

facet_scales

Axis scale argument passed to facet_wrap: "free" (default), "fixed", "free_x", or "free_y".

add_density

Logical. If TRUE, adds 2D density contours (default FALSE).

x_lab

Optional custom x-axis label. NULL auto-derives from x_col.

y_lab

Optional custom y-axis label. NULL auto-derives from y_col.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

nhood_diversity, nhood_shm, nhood_cdr3_convergence, plot_nhood_beeswarm

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Fixed-size points
plot_nhood_scatter(
  nhood_data = nhood_data,
  x_col      = "shannon_diversity",
  y_col      = "mean_shm",
  colour_by  = "anat"
)

# Point size mapped to neighbourhood size, with a custom size range
plot_nhood_scatter(
  nhood_data = nhood_data,
  x_col      = "shannon_diversity",
  y_col      = "mean_shm",
  colour_by  = "anat",
  size_by    = "nhood_size",
  size       = c(2, 8)
)
} # }
